method: Approximate visible pavement edges manually interpreted on 25 m transects, with additional 5 m observations from 130 through 170 m around the apex of the pinned CartoCiudad 300 m clip. Tangent uses +/-2 m station window; signed offset follows EPSG left normal (-dy,dx). Linear interpolation between observations is inference, not a boundary survey. Shadows, curbs and imagery date are unresolved. Revision 4 independently reinterprets pinned-photo pavement boundaries at 5 m spacing in 50-75, 175-200 and 275-300 m windows. The image is sampled along the same +/-2 m tangent transects; UE signed offsets are converted to EPSG left normal by [min,max]=[-UEmax,-UEmin]. Painted lines, roadside gravel, parapets and shadow boundaries are distinguished where visible; unresolved edge interpretation retains the 1 m review allowance.
uncertainty_is: review allowance, not measured statistical accuracy

review_history.trigger: Contact trial rejected; middle-width fit inspection found extreme departures near stations 125-128 and 175-177 m.
review_history.review: Magnified pinned-photo transects show initial estimates at 125 and 175 extended beyond pavement into roadside ground; reinterpreted edges. This is source interpretation correction, not automated narrowing to meet contact thresholds.
review_history.remaining_limits: 13 transects and interpolation remain coarse, especially near the hairpin; imagery age, shadows and edge accuracy are unresolved. No width/earthwork/physics admission.

review_history.trigger: Street View confirms separate hairpin island; coarse edge interpolation around apex requires closer photo review.
review_history.review: Added independent 5 m transect observations on the same pinned orthophoto at 130,135,140,145,155,160,165,170 m. Read visible asphalt boundary rather than assuming painted edge line or using contact failures to narrow the road.
review_history.remaining_limits: Manual approximate interpretation; imagery acquisition date and native GSD unresolved; no survey, earthworks or physics admission.

review_history.trigger: Bounded profile assessment flagged large differences at 60.5, 180.5 and 290.5 m.
review_history.review: Read both edges independently from chainage/lateral strips of the pinned PNOA image before recomputing heights. Added 5 m observations in three windows; this shifts and sometimes widens the footprint, rather than optimizing it against cut/fill thresholds. July 2026 Street View confirms stone parapets beside drops and uphill rock/vegetation near the reviewed sections.
review_history.remaining_limits: Street View selects nearby camera positions, not exact transects; it supplies no metric boundary or wall dimensions. PNOA acquisition date, native GSD, shadows and epoch registration remain unresolved. Other windows retain earlier interpretation. No survey, earthworks, physics or learning admission.
